# Velociti

> Velociti is an AI-native enterprise engineering company headquartered in Dubai. Forward-deployed engineers map how a business really runs, prototype AI agents in weeks and harden them into production systems across finance, sales, marketing and operations. Canonical site: https://thinkvelociti.com (formerly velociti.club).

## Solutions
- [Finance](https://thinkvelociti.com/solutions#finance): reconciliation and close, payables and receivables, FP&A reporting, with a controller approving whenever a number matters.
- [Sales](https://thinkvelociti.com/solutions#sales): autonomous SDRs for outbound research, inbound qualification and CRM hygiene.
- [Marketing](https://thinkvelociti.com/solutions#marketing): on-brand content, segmentation and weekly performance reporting, approved by a marketer.
- [Operations](https://thinkvelociti.com/solutions#operations): approvals, hand-offs and exceptions orchestrated across ERP, ticketing and documents.
- [Customer Support](https://thinkvelociti.com/solutions#support): voice, chat, email and WhatsApp agents that resolve L1 and L2 issues in any language.
- [Enterprise Knowledge](https://thinkvelociti.com/solutions#knowledge): a permission-aware RAG layer with citations on every answer.

## Delivery
- [Forward Deployed Engineers](https://thinkvelociti.com/engineers): a pod of a Forward Deployed Engineer and an AI Strategist. Engagements move from Velociti-led to client-owned; typically 8–14 weeks from kickoff to production.
- Deployment options: managed cloud, single-tenant, the client's VPC (AWS, Azure, GCP), or on-prem / airgapped with zero internet egress.

## Industries
Healthcare, Finance, Oil & Gas, Mining, Automotive, Pharma, Government, Hospitality, Education: https://thinkvelociti.com/industries

## Results (published case studies)
- Healthcare: 99.2% claim pre-verification accuracy, 35% faster processing — https://thinkvelociti.com/customers/clinical-claim-pre-verification
- Finance: +42% auto-loan underwriting throughput, −31% review time, 100% audit log coverage — https://thinkvelociti.com/customers/auto-loan-underwriting
- Oil & Gas: −18% unplanned downtime, −15% maintenance OPEX, 94% alert accuracy — https://thinkvelociti.com/customers/predictive-valve-telemetry
- Automotive: −24% QA cycle time, −12% defects — https://thinkvelociti.com/customers/assembly-line-anomaly-detection

## Trust
Human-in-the-loop approvals, immutable audit logs, PII redaction, prompt-injection defence, AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. Client data never trains public models. Compliance status: https://thinkvelociti.com/trust
